title: How To Open Any Stuck Jar Lid 🫙 #Shorts
description:
How to open a stuck jar lid: it's not your grip, it's the air. A sealed jar has a vacuum inside, less air in the jar than outside, so the air outside presses the lid down onto the glass and jams the seal. Slide a spoon under the edge of the lid and lift gently until it hisses: air gets in and the seal breaks. Still stuck? Run hot tap water on the metal lid. Metal expands more than glass when it heats up, so the lid loosens a little. Then twist.

Explained in 60, podcast edition. You've Been Doing It Wrong.
